verdict.rationale: Plugging MCP servers into a Git forge is a fair question, since forges can ship built-in agents that consume external tools. GitCafe's evidence covers only the server role: its hosted MCP server at /mcp, WebMCP tools offered to browser agents, and handing issues off to external coding agents. Nothing shows GitCafe itself connecting to or using third-party MCP servers, and server-side capability does not count toward this client story.
